definitions.explanation: A general term for dishes that are primarily liquid, such as miso soup, clear soup, or various broths served as part of a Japanese meal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{和食|わしょく}→和食：10436_washoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{汁物|しるもの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠|か}かせない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧。
examples.english: A soup dish is essential in a Japanese meal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{汁物|しるもの}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{豚汁|とんじる}→豚汁：14229_tonjiru⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Today's soup dish is pork miso soup.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一汁三菜|いちじゅうさんさい}→一汁三菜：08952_ichijuusansai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧「⟦{汁|しる}→汁：10462_shiru⟧」⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{汁物|しるもの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The 'soup' in 'one soup, three dishes' refers to a soup dish.

notes:
USAGE: {汁物|しるもの} is a category term used in ⟦{和食|わしょく}→和食：10436_washoku⟧ (Japanese cuisine) to describe any soup or liquid-based dish. It is one of the core components of a traditional Japanese meal.

COMMON TYPES:
・⟦{味噌汁|みそしる}→味噌汁：04954_misoshiru⟧ (miso soup)
・⟦{吸|す}い{物|もの}→吸い物：04990_suimono⟧/⟦お{吸|す}い{物|もの}→お吸い物：15773_osuimono⟧ (clear soup)
・⟦{豚汁|とんじる}→豚汁：14229_tonjiru⟧/⟦とん{汁|じる}→豚汁：14229_tonjiru⟧ (pork miso soup)
・⟦けんちん{汁|じる}→けんちん汁：29412_kenchinjiru⟧ (vegetable soup with tofu)
・⟦{粕汁|かすじる}→粕汁：24970_kasujiru⟧ (sake lees soup)

CULTURAL CONTEXT:
⟦{一汁三菜|いちじゅうさんさい}→一汁三菜：08952_ichijuusansai⟧ (one soup, three side dishes) is the traditional format for a Japanese meal:
・⟦{飯|はん}→飯：noentry⟧ (rice) - main starch
・{汁物|しるもの} (soup) - liquid dish
・⟦{菜|さい}→菜：noentry⟧ (three side dishes) - vegetables, protein, etc.

This balanced format is still considered the ideal for healthy Japanese home cooking.
